title: venueFill
description: One standard-shape venue fill: a completed trade on any venue (Alpaca paper account, Hive-Engine, or an internal market), ready to be turned into a Beancount transaction. Provisional pending the computer-data seat's standard-fill-quote-mandate-schemas (task:standard-fill-quote-mandate-schemas, not yet fabricated).

venue.description: The venue that executed the fill, e.g. "hive-engine", "alpaca", "internal-market".

account.description: The venue-side account or identity that executed the fill, e.g. a Hive account name or an Alpaca account id.

fillId.description: The venue's own unique identifier for this fill (a Hive-Engine transaction id, an Alpaca order id).

side.description: "buy" acquires baseCommodity by paying quoteCommodity; "sell" disposes baseCommodity for quoteCommodity.

baseQuantity.description: Positive plain decimal string; the exact base-commodity quantity traded.

quoteAmount.description: Positive plain decimal string; the exact quote-commodity amount actually settled on the custody account for this fill, before any separately-posted fee. A venue fee already embedded in this amount (an AMM pool fee, never a separate wallet movement) is not represented by `feeAmount`; carry it informationally as venuePoolFee instead.

feeAmount.description: Positive plain decimal string; a fee that moves as an ADDITIONAL separate posting distinct from quoteAmount (e.g. an Alpaca commission). Zero when the venue charges no separate fee or nets it invisibly into quoteAmount.

feeAccount.description: The Beancount Expenses:Investment:Fees:<Venue> account to post feeAmount to; required when feeAmount is nonzero.

custodyAccount.description: The single Beancount account holding both baseCommodity and quoteCommodity for this venue/account (an existing ledger account name, never invented).

mandateId.description: The strategy or mandate id this fill executes under, or "manual".

narration.description: Optional narration override; defaults to "<venue> <side> <baseCommodity> for <quoteCommodity>".

witnessBlock.description: The venue's block/ledger height at which the fill settled, when the venue is chain-based.

witnesses.description: Independent reads of this fill, one per node/source consulted. When two or more are present and their databaseHash values disagree, the fill is refused rather than booked.

venuePoolFee.description: Informational only, never posted: a venue-reported fee already netted into quoteAmount (e.g. a Hive-Engine marketpools swap's pool fee).
